doc_friction.issue: SimFeeder's rpm_full sets the board's told WHEEL_RPM_FULL, not the simulated wheel's free speed (that is wheel_max_rpm); the name invites the wrong one (caught before the run).

goal: settle the fit floor on held-out builds and measure the hold's lateness
notes: Held-out sweep (tests/min_fit_heldout.py; decision rule committed in its own commit before the run): 18 builds on launchers, lags, plants, seed and slow targets no earlier sweep used. Floor stays 1,000 (pooled spin error 0.57% at 500 vs 0.56% at 1,000; ESC worst 2.33 vs 1.47%). The hold made slow->fast shots 0.63 s (3 s interval) / 0.88 s (2 s) late on average, 113/144 and 141/144 over 0.25 s. New opt-in controller/host LOOP_THROUGH_CHANGE keeps the slow wheel's watch through the next speed change: 0 of 468 gaps late, drops as accurate, spin error better on first-order and ESC, worse on the jittery tach (worst 2.16 vs 1.26%); off by default pending a real wheel. Verification: pytest tests/ 192 passed (88 s); post front matter, links, similarity clean; venture-preflight run (output in PR).
